content.short: Geth is an Ethereum execution client implemented in Go.
content.description: Go Ethereum (Geth) is among the original implementations of the Ethereum protocol. With Geth, developers can write DApps in Go, a language well suited for fast, concurrent programming. As a robust and efficient Ethereum execution client, Geth remains the most widely used option, powering over 80% of nodes. To help maintain network resilience, it is advised to run additional clients alongside Geth to preserve ecosystem diversity.
